title: How do we write six numbers in Egyptian symbols?
description: Six numbers are written in the Egyptian system by the method of the solved example, with the biggest landmark first, as many times as it fits. The video uses the stroke, heel, coil, lotus and finger, and then adds the values back to check. A landmark with no symbols is left out of the numeral.
teaching_notes: One idea: take the biggest landmark that fits, as many times as it fits, and then move down. A landmark that does not fit gets no symbols. Watch for students who forget the finger for ten thousand or write ten of one symbol.

video_script.why: The child uses the method of the solved example, biggest landmark first, on six new numbers.
video_script.substitution: Take the biggest landmark that fits, as many times as it fits, then move down to the next landmark.
video_script.anchor: six numbers, 10458, 1023, 2660, 784, 1111 and 70707, beside the five Egyptian symbols
video_script.payoff_line: Write the biggest landmark first, as many times as it fits, and move down

final_answer.value: 10458: 1 finger, 4 coils, 5 heels, 8 strokes; 1023: 1 lotus, 2 heels, 3 strokes; 2660: 2 lotuses, 6 coils, 6 heels; 784: 7 coils, 8 heels, 4 strokes; 1111: one of each of lotus, coil, heel, stroke; 70707: 7 fingers, 7 coils, 7 strokes
final_answer.spoken: ten thousand four hundred fifty eight is one finger, four coils, five heels and eight strokes; one thousand twenty three is one lotus, two heels and three strokes; two thousand six hundred sixty is two lotuses, six coils and six heels; seven hundred eighty four is seven coils, eight heels and four strokes; one thousand one hundred eleven is one each of a lotus, a coil, a heel and a stroke; seventy thousand seven hundred seven is seven fingers, seven coils and seven strokes

hold_back: 10458: 1 finger, 4 coils, 5 heels, 8 strokes; 1023: 1 lotus, 2 heels, 3 strokes; 2660: 2 lotuses, 6 coils, 6 heels; 784: 7 coils, 8 heels, 4 strokes; 1111: one of each of lotus, coil, heel, stroke; 70707: 7 fingers, 7 coils, 7 strokes
never_show: the answer card before the last beat of the board solution
maths_rules: 1023 = 1000 + 20 + 3: 1 lotus, no coils, 2 heels and 3 strokes
2660 = 2000 + 600 + 60: 2 lotuses, 6 coils and 6 heels, no strokes
1111 = 1000 + 100 + 10 + 1: one lotus, one coil, one heel and one stroke
check: add the values back to get each number

narration: <bookmark mark='s5'/>Step five, put the values back to check each numeral.
<bookmark mark='m8'/>Ten thousand plus four hundred plus fifty plus eight makes the first number.
<bookmark mark='m9'/>One thousand plus twenty plus three makes the second number. Two thousand plus six hundred plus sixty makes the third.
<bookmark mark='m10'/>Seven hundred plus eighty plus four makes the fourth. One thousand plus one hundred plus ten plus one makes the fifth.
<bookmark mark='m11'/>Seventy thousand plus seven hundred plus seven makes the last number.
